Package hadur2.core.link

Class LinkCodec

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.link.LinkCodec
public final class LinkCodec extends Object
LINK-1: a Report as bytes and back. Big-endian, doubles as their raw bits, so a report reads back exactly (CORE-2). 
 'H' 'L' version:u8 round:u16 tick:i64
 x y heading velocity energy:f64
 sightings:u8 { name tick:i64 x y heading velocity energy:f64 }
 deaths:u8 { name }
 shots:u8 { tick:i64 x y heading power:f64 }
 crc:i32                      CRC-32 of every byte before it
 name = length:u8 then that many UTF-16 chars:u16

LINK-2: decode(byte[]) refuses a message whose checksum fails, whose version is not VERSION, or that is cut short or runs long, by throwing LinkFormatException; the caller ignores it and counts it. Pure byte work: no I/O (RES-6).
